meta.title: Moonvale Defense — Tower Defense on Solana
meta.desc: Tower defense on Solana: summon towers from boxes, fuse three alike to climb stars and rarities, play as a duo and race the weekly ranking. Demo live now.
nav.label: Sections
lang.label: Language
hero.pitch: Tower defense on Solana. Summon towers from boxes, fuse three alike to grow stronger and defend the vale wave after wave.
hero.note: Runs in the browser, on phone and PC.
play.title: How it plays
play.lead: Enemies follow the path. You place towers around it, spend gold on upgrades and hold out wave after wave.
alt.map: The Glade map seen from above: a dirt path winds through the field and crosses the river on a bridge
play.map.title: Maps with paths
play.map.text: Every map has its own path and every tower has its own ground. When you pick a tower, the map shows where it can go.
play.classes.title: 8 tower classes
play.classes.text: Seven classes attack. The Moonlight Orchard never attacks: it makes gold.
zone.thief: Right by the path, sees camo
zone.orchard: Far from the path, makes gold
play.up.title: 3 upgrade paths
play.up.text: Each tower has 3 paths with 5 tiers. You invest in 2, and only 1 goes past tier 2. Every attacking tower has a path that sees camo and one that beats armor.
play.endless.title: Endless run
play.endless.text: Endless waves and a weekly ranking with the top 50.
play.duo.title: Duo
play.duo.text: Defend the same map with a friend, with duo chat and map pings.
play.daily.title: Missions, lives and level
play.daily.text: Daily missions, daily login, lives that refill over time and a player level with a knowledge tree.
play.chat.title: World chat in 6 languages
play.chat.text: Game and world chat in Portuguese, English, Spanish, Thai, Japanese and Chinese.
coll.title: Collection: rarity and stars
coll.lead: Rarity is the big step. Inside each rarity, a tower climbs from 1 to 5 stars.
coll.ladder: 8 rarities, from Common to Cosmic, each with 5 stars
coll.ladderNote: 8 rarities, from Common to Cosmic. The top is Cosmic with 5 stars.
coll.boxes.title: Boxes
coll.boxes.text: Each box summons a Common tower of 1 to 5 stars and, rarely, an Uncommon 1 star. The class is one of the 8, all equally likely.
coll.fuse.title: Fusion
coll.fuse.text: 3 identical towers (same class, rarity and stars) become 1 with one more star.
coll.up.title: Next rarity
coll.up.text: Three 5-star towers become 1 of the next rarity, with 1 star. From Rare upward, only through fusion.
pre.title: Presale: founder packs
pre.lead: Limited-time packs, until the coin launch. You use everything right now, in the demo.

g.mural: Your name on the Founders Wall
g.tower: Tower of the class you pick: {r}
pre.note: You buy inside the game: Shop, Founder packs, paid in SOL. Max lives and refill time do not stack between packs (the best one counts).
pre.r1: 100% of the presale SOL buys the new Moonvale Defense coin at launch and becomes the players' reward reserve.
pre.r2: If the coin has not launched by December 15, 2026 (Brasilia time), every buyer gets all the SOL back, to the same wallet that paid.
pre.r3: There is no guarantee of the coin value: its price can go up, go down or reach zero.
pre.r4: The pack is tied to your account (your wallet) and is valid at launch. You use everything right now, in the demo.
pre.r5: Minors may only buy with the permission of a parent or guardian.
road.title: Roadmap
road.1.d: Play now in the browser at moonvaleonline.com/td.
road.2.d: Founder packs inside the game, until the coin launch.
road.3.d: The presale SOL buys the new coin, which becomes the players' reward reserve.
